lines: Needle's tip, spear's tip, somewhere globe-piercing:
the one form may be seen — knowledge-cause arose.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ātmano nirvikārasya kva jñānaṃ kva ca vā kriyā | jñānāyattā bahirbhāvā ataḥ śūnyam idaṃ jagat

reads_against.argmap: Where are knowing and action? → Self needs no knowing nor action — outer world is void of both.
c1_essence: Self needs neither knowing nor action: world void.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with śānta (wonder settled into stillness)
